verdict.rationale: Sentry's Seer delivers AI-generated insights inside the product. Autofix scans incoming issues to find root causes, automate triage, and generate fix PRs. Seer Agent answers natural-language questions about your application by pulling the right telemetry, and Seer also reviews code changes. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, and documentation depth beyond short feature summaries (e.g., how insights surface in dashboards, issues, and other UI views).
